▪️ At the joint meeting of the Committee on Provincial Affairs of the Reformists Front of Iran with the presiding boards of the provincial reformist fronts, he proposed that speeches and meetings related to the issue of peace and the Islamabad Agreement be held across the country with greater speed, with the participation of all reformists—both members active in organizational meetings and other forces of this movement.

▪️ Saharkhiz also identified the launch of an online campaign in support of the Islamabad Agreement as another necessary step, expressing hope that it would be widely welcomed by a people weary of war.

▪️ The Head of the Reformists Front of Gilan Province, referring to the media capacity of reformists in the provinces, stressed the need to centrally activate news outlets and media close to this movement, and called on the public relations and media committee of the Reformists Front of Iran to play a more effective role in coordinating these capacities.

▪️ In conclusion, he stressed the need to plan for utilizing the organizational and media capacities of reformists in support of peace and agreement.

❇️ Head of the Reform Front of Hormozgan Province: Support for the agreement must be carried out with the participation of all pillars of the government and political currents

🔺 Mohammad Zakeri, Head of the Reform Front of Hormozgan Province, emphasizing the importance of the Islamabad Agreement, said: Without a doubt, this agreement is a great and unprecedented step that is the result of sacrifices, courage, and political and social efforts made in the country.

▪️ Referring to the need to avoid politicizing this movement, he stated: In order for support for the agreement to bear fruit, the pillars of the government must first clarify their position, and governance institutions and principled figures who agree with this path must also step forward. Governors must also play a role in this process so that the ground is prepared for synergy among different sectors.

▪️ Zakeri added: If only the Reform Front is to take the lead and the main burden of this movement falls on the shoulders of the reformists, the work will not reach the desired result and the movement will remain incomplete. Given the unfavorable conditions of many provinces and the costs that gathering forces entails, it is necessary that this action begin at the level of the government and the pillars of governance and then expand in the provinces.

▪️ The Head of the Reform Front of Hormozgan Province proposed that before entering into field actions, the capacity for support of the agreement in cyberspace should be measured and the level of public reception should be evaluated, so that if the ground is prepared, executive and field plans can be pursued with stronger backing.

❇️ Head of the Reform Front of Hamadan Province: Supporting the Islamabad Agreement Requires Serious Action by the Government

🔺Ali Mehrabadi, Head of the Reform Front of Hamadan Province, speaking at a joint meeting of the Committee for Provincial Affairs of the Reform Front of Iran with the board of directors of the provincial reform fronts, held to examine ways of supporting the Islamabad Agreement, noted several positive steps taken after the agreement was signed — including the lifting of the naval blockade, the resumption of Iran's oil sales, and negotiations for the return of the country's assets — and stressed the need to clarify what has caused the agreement to stall.

▪️Stating that unless it is determined how much responsibility each party bears for derailing the agreement, and as long as leniency is shown in this regard, support campaigns will not achieve the desired outcome, he said: Supporting the agreement requires, beyond civil actions and popular campaigns, serious and responsible action by official authorities, especially the government.

▪️Ali Mehrabadi noted that despite the follow-ups, no permit has yet been issued for a gathering in support of the agreement, which the Reform Front of Iran had previously requested, and added: As long as marginal confrontations and the chanting of harsh slogans continue at nighttime gatherings, and no appropriate action is taken by official authorities — particularly the government — to manage these conditions, such campaigns in support of the agreement will yield little and will not be widely embraced by the public.

▪️In conclusion, the Head of the Reform Front of Hamadan Province, while commending the intentions of the organizers of these campaigns, expressed hope that these efforts will bear fruit, and emphasized: Alongside these actions, it is essential that Mr. Pezeshkian and the government take serious and effective measures to support those who find themselves in these difficult conditions.

🔹The Reform Front of Iran's address on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)

❇️ Examining ways to support the Islamabad Agreement at a joint meeting of the Committee for Provincial Affairs of the Iran Reform Front with the presiding boards of the provincial reform fronts

🔺 A virtual meeting was held between members of the Committee for Provincial Affairs of the Iran Reform Front and the heads and members of the presiding boards of the provincial reform fronts, focused on examining ways for the provinces to participate in the national campaign to support the Islamabad Agreement, promoting peace-seeking, and efforts to end the war.

▪️ The guest of the meeting was Ali Shakouri-Rad, who is in charge of launching the national campaign to support the Islamabad Agreement. Outlining the goals and plans of the campaign, he described support for the agreement as a national and cross-factional endeavor and emphasized that this document was built on strong foundations—including its approval by the Supreme National Security Council, confirmation by the Leadership, and the signing of the presidents of the two countries—and should not be easily cast aside.

▪️ Pointing to the need to strengthen the voice of supporters of peace and understanding in the country's public sphere, he said: "The goal of the campaign is to create social momentum and pave the way for a more active presence of moderate forces and supporters of the agreement in the public arena—forces that, in his view, despite backing this path, have so far lacked a prominent presence and voice."

▪️ Ali Shakouri-Rad, emphasizing the importance of the Islamabad Agreement in the process of ending the war, described it as a starting point for subsequent Iran-US talks and stated that even amid disagreement and conflict, the parties cite the provisions of this agreement to advance their positions. Preserving this document and pursuing its provisions can therefore serve as a basis for continuing negotiations and reaching further understandings.

▪️ The official in charge of launching the campaign also announced meetings with foreign policy experts and the formation of specialized committees to advance the plans, stressing the need to expand this movement to the provinces. According to him, holding brainstorming sessions with experts and influential provincial figures can help clarify the dimensions of the agreement and strengthen social participation in support of peace.

▪️ The meeting continued with discussions and an exchange of views on how the provincial reform fronts can join the campaign, the holding of provincial meetings, and the mechanism for coordinating activities at the national and provincial levels.

❇️ Ebrahim Asgharzadeh Summoned to Security Prosecutor's Office to Present His Final Defense

🔺 Ebrahim Asgharzadeh, a member of the board of directors and head of the political committee of the Iran Reform Front, appeared today at Branch 2 of the Security Prosecutor's Office, where he was interrogated in connection with the case concerning the Front's statement on the Dey 18 and 19 catastrophe, and presented his final defense.

◾️ During this session, Asgharzadeh criticized how security and judicial bodies have handled the Iran Reform Front's statement, calling the approach selective, and explained that parts of the statement had been picked out and highlighted apart from their context and the overall content, and cited as grounds for charges.

◾️ Pointing to the consequences of such an approach, he emphasized that if statements are to be cited selectively, one could likewise isolate parts of the remarks of senior officials of the system, disregarding their background and what follows in their words, and draw quite different interpretations.

◾️ The head of the political committee of the Iran Reform Front also emphasized that the Front's statement should be examined and judged not as an individual act, but as a collective act, in connection with the chain of activities of the Iran Reform Front.

◾️ The statement in question was published last Bahman in reaction to the events of Dey 18 and 19, and a judicial case has been opened over it for a number of members of the board of directors of the Iran Reform Front.

🔹The Iran Reform Front's addresses on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)
